He tucked the paper into his coat, lit the great lamp as he always did, and let the sea keep its other secrets a while longer.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。街灯昏黄，照着空荡荡的马路，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下一道短暂的光。早餐铺的卷帘门缓缓升起，热气从蒸笼里升腾。清洁工挥动扫帚，沙沙声在寂静里格外清晰。远处高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有零星几盏灯亮着，不知是失眠的人，还是早起的人。天边泛起一丝微光，黎明将至，城市正悄悄苏醒，等待新一天的喧嚣。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n• Imagine standing between two mirrors—you see yourself again and again, each time a little smaller.\n• It stops when the problem gets so small there's an easy answer, like counting down to zero."}
